notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have released an update that includes the errors you reported to us and changes related to gameplay.

[list]
[*] The stamina depletion bug when the run button is pressed while crouching has been fixed.
[*] Most of the translation errors in the Italian translation have been addressed.
[*] The issue causing the game to become locked when pressing the "ESC" key while in conversation with the cashier has been resolved.
[*] The majority of text overflow problems in certain languages have been corrected.
[*] Optimization has been applied to the artificial intelligence's attack system.
[/list]

You can report any bugs or provide feedback in the Discussion section of the Community Center or through the soon-to-be-available website at https://bugs.longshiftstudios.com.

Thank you.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have released an update that includes the errors you reported to us and changes related to gameplay.

[list]
[*] Correction made in the dialogue with stranger in English subtitles.
[*] Opening of the prison room's door has been changed.
[*] Fix applied for the enemy attacking you suddenly while in a crouched mode.
[*] The number of squats in the "Congratulations" achievement has been reduced from 54 to 5. (Hint: Any corner of a rug inside the house)
[*] Issue resolved where the outside of the house was visible when looking out from the basement exit room's door.
[*] Restriction and optimization introduced for excessive background-running code.
[/list]

You can report any bugs or provide feedback in the Discussion section of the Community Center or through the soon-to-be-available website at https://bugs.longshiftstudios.com.

Thank you.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you for your interest. We have made some minor fixes for the issues that appeared in the initial release.

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where items were still visible in the inventory after being used or discarded.
[*] Fixed the bug where the antenna would glitch when placing it while the television was turned off.
[*] Removed the names of the cabinets in the kitchen that couldn't be interacted with.
[*] Resolved some problems with the Russian translation.
[*] Resolved some issues with the German translation.
[*] Fixed the error that displayed "bookshelf" instead of "closet" on clothing cabinets.
[*] Fixed the bug where rain sound wouldn't play when getting out of the car.
[*] Fixed the issue where the F key appeared as usable on lamps.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added the translation "Left Click" for every language instead of LMB.
[*] Added the usage prompts to the lower left corner for the antenna, similar to other interactable items like Padlocks and Lockpicks.
[/list]

You can report any bugs or provide feedback in the Discussion section of the Community Center or through the soon-to-be-available website at https://bugs.longshiftstudios.com.

Thank you.
